name: mop
description: Slop mops: audit what a branch changed and clean it up, with proof nothing broke. mop routes by file type; mop:tests, mop:code, mop:docs and mop:ui each run one detect, fix and verify loop; mop:break attacks the result and fixes what it can reproduce.

interface.shortDescription: Clean up what a branch changed, with proof
interface.longDescription: Sorts a branch's changed files by type and runs a slop mop on each group: tests, code, docs and UI. Each mop fixes slop on the lines the branch owns and proves nothing broke; mop:break then attacks the result and fixes the holes it can reproduce.
defaultPrompt: Consolidate the tests this branch touched.
Try to break the code this branch changed.
